mapper.insert: INSERT INTO merchant (full_name, short_name, biz_type, currency, country, state, city, address, email, phone, status) VALUES (#{pojo.fullName}, #{pojo.shortName}, #{pojo.bizType}, #{pojo.currency}, #{pojo.country}, #{pojo.state}, #{pojo.city}, #{pojo.address}, #{pojo.email}, #{pojo.phone}, 1)
mapper.update: UPDATE merchant SET full_name = #{pojo.fullName}, short_name = #{pojo.shortName}, biz_type = #{pojo.bizType}, country = #{pojo.country}, state = #{pojo.state}, city = #{pojo.city}, address = #{pojo.address}, email = #{pojo.email}, phone = #{pojo.phone}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{pojo.id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM merchant WHERE email = #{email} LIMIT 1
